name: Afromedia PLC

rows.label: Total assets
rows.source: Afromedia Plc audited accounts on the NGX filing library. FY2022 and FY2021 from the FY2022 annual report (doclib 39227, approved by the board 31 March 2023); FY2020 (15 months ended 31 December 2020) and FY2019 (year ended 30 September 2019) from the FY2020 annual report (doclib 33322), statement and five year summary; FY2018, FY2017 and FY2016 from the five year financial summary on page 65 of the FY2021 annual report (doclib 35538) and page 66 of the FY2020 annual report, which agree with each other. Filed in NGN thousands, stored here in absolute NGN. Fiscal year end moved from 30 September to 31 December, so FY2020 covers 15 months.

source: Afromedia Plc audited accounts, NGX filing library. FY2022 and FY2021 as filed in the FY2022 annual report (doclib 39227, page 4); FY2020 (15 months ended 31 December 2020) and FY2019 (year ended 30 September 2019) from the FY2020 annual report statement of financial position (doclib 33322, page 16) and its five year summary (page 66); FY2018, FY2017 and FY2016 from the five year financial summary on page 65 of the FY2021 annual report (doclib 35538) and page 66 of the FY2020 report, which agree. Every column ties: non-current plus current assets equals total assets, non-current plus current liabilities equals total liabilities, and assets equal liabilities plus equity. Filed in NGN thousands, stored in absolute NGN. FY2015 dropped: no audited source supports the single figure that was held for it.
note: FY2019 to FY2016 replace figures taken from an interim five year summary page whose column dates could not be settled; these are the audited annual report values. Cash & Equivalents is blank before FY2020 because the five year summaries do not print it.
